finalText:
It builds clean now. The bump had left two real bugs hiding behind all that deprecation noise.

1. `src/core/options.js` still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Fixed to read the right field.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` threw on `undefined`, but the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`. Now it treats `undefined` as disabled.

Build exits 0, with just the 8 harmless deprecation warnings from the bump itself.
